I bought a mini split a/c for my garage, but I ended up kinking the 1/2" line while trying to run the line through the attic, to fix it, I cut out the kink, and I bought a couple couplers but I needed to flare the new copper line ends, I picked this flare tool up and it did the job perfectly, mind you I have never flared a copper line ever in my life, and the end result was as professional as it gets, so much so I had to take a picture of it, and after the repair there were no leaks!

Dropped it on stone paths a few times, no cracks or broken parts. Tough plastic holds up to rough outdoor use.
This metal detector works amazing for backyard and beach trips. It picks up coins, rings and small jewelry clearly without too many false signals. Perfect for casual treasure lovers.
Telescopic rod folds down short, fits easily in my backpack for camping and seaside vacations.
Separate modes for junk metal, valuable metals and pinpoint search. I can ignore iron scraps and zero in on gold or silver fast.
This detector meets all my outdoor searching needs, I will buy another as a spare unit later.
